It is derived from the Greek name Rhiannon, which means 'queen' or 'maiden'. In modern times, the name has been popularized by the singer Rihanna, who was born Robyn Rihanna Fenty in 1988. Rhianna's music career began in 2005, and she has since become one of the best-selling artists of all time. Her fashion sense has also been influential, particularly in the areas of makeup and hairstyles. Social media platforms such as Instagram and Twitter have played a significant role in the spread of the name Rhianna, as fans and admirers use these platforms to share images and information related to the singer and her music.
